scope: General native text capture for off-canvas fixed surfaces, tested through package-independent MCP host browser tasks
sourceBinding: Final source hashes bind native-fixed-menu-final-01, mcp-browser-public-host-concert-01 and mcp-public-native-catalogue-final-01. Earlier intermediate source revisions were not individually hashed; commands, executed tests, native captures, full logs and failures remain retained.

value.policy: Goals only enter planners; expectedPatterns/expectedHost and oracle sources are external test assertions. Original full tasks remain unchanged after first inference.

travel.goal: Open https://www.bart.gov/tickets/discounts. Tell me which ages qualify for the youth discount, how much the discount is, which card is required, and which children ride free. Include the official source link.
travel.oracle: Ages 5–18 receive 50% off using Youth Clipper; children 4 and younger ride free.

concert.goal: Open https://www.sfjazz.org/tickets/ticket-policies/. Tell me the flat fee and advance-notice deadline for returning SFJAZZ concert tickets for box-office credit, and which membership level waives the fee. Include the official source link. Do not return or purchase any tickets.
concert.oracle: $25 flat return fee; accepted up to 48 hours prior to performance; waived at Contributor level ($250/year) and above.

frozenTasks.note: Frozen before public-task inference. Only goals enter planners; expected patterns/host and reference answers remain test assertions. The complete tasks were not rewritten after failure.

nativeCapture.tested: Two executed red methods precede passing native fixed-menu and visible fixed-scroll-panel checks. Final seven-method regression bundle passes with no skips; final native BART experiment also passes and independently exposes all fare facts.
nativeCapture.accepted: Scoped read-only native text/link capture; arbitrary clipping/occlusion and general task reliability are not established.

packageIndependentHost.tested: Same actual default host/helper/Apple planner/production browser loader controlled task completes in 10.750723 seconds, one visit per page and zero downloads/launch attempts/workers.
packageIndependentHost.accepted: Controlled informational workflow; no full HostSession/provider/phone claim.

publicTravelTask.tested: Initial 16.11-second task and 13.96-second diagnostic fail. After first capture repair, all original fare facts appear but actual Apple planning raises a guardrail error at 23.14 seconds. Zero CU workers and launches.

publicConcertTask.tested: Actual planner generates all independently expected fee/deadline/membership/source facts, but host rejects the answer from one of two record views. Full task fails at 16.94 seconds, with zero CU workers and launches.

findings: Initial BART native catalogue stops after 176 texts, 128 links and 256 containers, before the fare content; truncated and omittedStructure are true. Actual planner proposes an unavailable-facts answer after its first view; the existing partial-view guard rejects it. This is not a token overflow: diagnostic reports 2889 context tokens with 4096 available.

A no-inference actual WKWebView experiment has both stylesheets present and document.readyState complete. At 960x569, its main navigation rectangle begins at x=960. Official CSS places the mobile navigation at position:fixed and right:-100vw. A separate CUA read corroborates a different desktop layout at a wider viewport; it is not substituted for the app evidence.

The shared reader previously accepted text rectangles from viewport-fixed surfaces wholly outside the viewport. Such menus can consume native capture limits even though document scrolling cannot expose them. No website selectors, task values or coordinates were added to production.

The reader now requires viewport intersection for viewport-fixed text/link/image-label surfaces. Transformed or contained fixed descendants retain document-scroll semantics. Visible scrolling fixed panels preserve their offscreen text. Ordinary offscreen text, partial fixed text and display:contents remain available.

Final native BART capture contains 93 texts, 51 links and 106 containers with both truncation flags false. All independently expected youth-fare facts are present. Readable native facts do not establish semantic whole-task completion.

The default host now accepts an optional browser-step planner value, with the production default unchanged. Tests use its existing opt-in observers to retain actual proposals and native records; no proposals are injected.

SFJAZZ actual proposal matches the complete frozen external oracle, but the existing partial-view completion restriction rejects it. Conversely, the initial BART unsupported/unavailable-facts proposal must remain rejected. These form paired evidence for a precise answer-admission repair.
BART actual Apple guardrail failure and misleading contextLimit classification for partial-view rejection remain unresolved. They do not demonstrate MCP incapability and do not trigger a CU model.
One main-thread responsiveness warning remains in the final seven-method bundle. Whole-Mac 12 GB/heat and production flicker are not qualified.
